title: ShockExamExtraction
description: Extract the five physical-examination findings a bedside shock-category rule needs, from a free-text clinical note. The output is the exact payload the shock-reasoning contract consumes.

x-notes.propertyOrder: LOAD-BEARING. The order is the order the prompt lists them, and the grammar compiles it: hypotension first (with nested properties), then heart_rate, then the five categorical findings in the order a clinician records them.

duration_minutes.description: How long the hypotension has persisted, in minutes

heart_rate.description: Heart rate in beats per minute

skin_temperature.description: Peripheral skin temperature assessed by touch

jugular_venous_pressure.description: Jugular venous pressure impression or measurement
